external_validation.index: Brent crude oil (FRED series DCOILBRENTEU), 3-day realized volatility of daily returns
external_validation.interpretation: No meaningful correlation found between the model's shipping P and Brent crude volatility at any tested lag — an honest null result.
external_validation.method: Pearson correlation between the sector's 3-day-smoothed calibrated P and Brent's 3-day realized return volatility, swept across lags of -14 to +14 days. Positive lag = P leads (moves before) volatility.
